The time after the unit is active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

graphical.target @47.847s
└─multi-user.target @47.746s
  └─NetworkManager.service @45.123s +2.500s
    └─dbus.socket @1.200s
      └─sysinit.target @1.100s
        └─systemd-udevd.service @234ms +12ms
